title: Krishna ne Narakasura ka ant kaise kiya?

mechanism: Defeats gatekeeper Mura with single arrow
Reveals inner demons need Krishna's grace

caption:
Krishna Pragjyotishpur pahunche, Narakasur ka ant ab hoga.
Bhagavata Purana ki yeh katha batati hai ki bahari rakshas hi nahi, andar ke Narakasur ko bhi Krishna hi maarte hain.
Aapke andar ka Narakasur kaun hai — krodh, lobh, ya ahankaar?

claims.claim: Narakasura (Bhaumasura) was the king of Pragjyotishapura and son of Bhoodevi
Narakasura stole Aditi's earrings and kidnapped 16,000 women
Krishna, accompanied by Satyabhama, defeated Narakasura and Mura
The story appears in Bhagavata Purana 10th Canto, Chapter 59
claims.basis: Critical edition of Bhagavata Purana (Skandha 10, Adhyaya 59)
